title: Existence of the normalized rational partial closed datum
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l with its specified valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme W on which l is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the rational tensor, admissible Hom pairs and internal-Hom object of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], the partial closed interface of [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces], and the integral partial closed datum of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. There exists a rational partial closed datum S such that for every object L, admissible pair P, integral arrow f from L's underlying integral object to the prescribed integral Hom object, and scalar a in the uniformizer localization, the inverse transpose of a tensor f is a tensor the integral inverse transpose of f, after the specified endpoint equalities. This assertion includes parameter naturality for arbitrary localized arrows, not merely pure tensors.

source.place: Step 5, coefficient transport; agent refinement proving the assigned scalar-localized closed normalization. The integral tensor-Hom adjunction is anchored by Stacks Project Tag 08J9 (sites-cohomology-lemma-internal-hom).

proof.text: Parameter naturality of the integral additive transpose, evaluated on r times the identity, and bilinearity of the integral tensor show that the transpose preserves scalar multiplication. Thus it is a linear equivalence.

Base change this linear equivalence and its inverse along the valuation-ring localization. Transport its endpoints using the specified rational tensor and internal-Hom object equalities. On pure tensors the inverse is exactly scalar times the integral inverse transpose.

Parameter naturality on two pure localized arrows follows from integral naturality, the bilinear tensor formula and localized composition. Induct on both tensor-product Hom modules, using additivity, to obtain naturality for all arrows. These equivalences and naturality form the required partial closed datum with the asserted normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem podRationalClosed_exists :
    ∃ S : PodPartialClosed (rationalDerivedTensor l E W)
        (constructibleRationalHomPairs l E W) (rationalDerivedInternalHom l E W),
      ∀ (L : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E W)
        (P : (constructibleRationalHomPairs l E W).FullSubcategory)
        (f : L.obj ⟶ (constructibleIntegralHom l E W).obj
          (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P))
        (a : Localization.Away (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))
        (q : L ⟶ (rationalDerivedInternalHom l E W).obj P),
        HEq q (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E] f) →
        HEq ((S.transpose L P).symm q)
          (a ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
            ((podIntegralClosed l E W).transpose L.obj
              (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E W P)).symm f)
